criteria.name: artifacts_exist
criteria.description: Every declared artifact exists under /app/out.

criteria.name: archive_members_safe_src_layout
criteria.description: patched-repo.zip has safe file members and the src layout with the visible tests.

criteria.name: api_entry_points_importable
criteria.description: The delivered package exposes every documented entry point from a foreign working directory.

criteria.name: cli_module_runs_from_foreign_cwd
criteria.description: python -m migrakit run with relative paths writes records.jsonl and run_summary.json in the caller folder.

criteria.name: visible_repo_tests_pass_from_archive
criteria.description: The nine visible repository tests pass when run from the extracted patched-repo.zip.

criteria.name: summary_json_matches_delivered_run
criteria.description: summary.json equals the run summary the delivered package produces for the shipped inputs.

criteria.name: module_core_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_core.json lists only core functions that differ from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: module_parser_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_parser.json lists only parser functions that differ from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: module_report_claims_match_archive
criteria.description: module_report.json lists only report functions that differ from the shipped repository.

criteria.name: test_fixes_matches_visible_test_runs
criteria.description: test_fixes.json records the real before and after result of each visible test.

criteria.name: repair_report_well_formed
criteria.description: repair-report.json names the package, lists fixes and at least one passed check.

criteria.name: signature_keeps_explicit_null
criteria.description: state_signature reports explicit null, value and absent for the prerequisite fields.

criteria.name: plan_tracks_field_dropped_earlier
criteria.description: The planner avoids a cheap edge whose operation removes a field a later prerequisite needs.

criteria.name: plan_uses_edge_enabled_earlier
criteria.description: The planner uses an edge whose prerequisite is created by an earlier add operation.

criteria.name: plan_revisits_schema_with_new_state
criteria.description: The cheapest plan passes the source schema twice after a state change and the planner returns it.

criteria.name: plan_renamed_null_satisfies_has
criteria.description: A renamed explicit null satisfies a later has prerequisite during planning.

criteria.name: plan_tie_first_edge_decides
criteria.description: Among equal-cost plans the first edge decides when last edges disagree.

criteria.name: plan_tie_longer_plan_wins
criteria.description: Among equal-cost plans a longer plan with the smaller edge-id list wins.

criteria.name: plan_unreachable_by_state
criteria.description: A graph whose schema paths all fail on field state raises E_UNREACHABLE.

criteria.name: ladder_small
criteria.description: Six-layer ladder with state-dependent edges and cost ties gets the documented plan.

criteria.name: ladder_medium_state
criteria.description: Sixteen-layer, four-wide ladder with state-dependent edges is planned within the time limit.

criteria.name: ladder_large_state
criteria.description: Forty-five-layer ladder with state-dependent edges is planned within the time limit.

criteria.name: ladder_large_tie
criteria.description: Forty-five-layer ladder full of equal-cost plans gets the smallest edge-id list within the time limit.

criteria.name: ladder_large_null
criteria.description: Forty-five-layer ladder gated on explicit-null fields is planned within the time limit.

criteria.name: exec_add_fill_absent_vs_null
criteria.description: add fills absent fields, and explicit nulls only where the fill mode allows it.

criteria.name: exec_operations_apply_in_order
criteria.description: rename, cast and drop apply left to right with the documented conversions.

criteria.name: exec_correction_unset_breaks_step2
criteria.description: An UNSET pinned to the intermediate schema makes step two fail with E_PREREQ_FAILED.

criteria.name: exec_correction_null_blocks_lacks
criteria.description: A NULL correction counts as present and blocks a lacks prerequisite during execution.

criteria.name: exec_correction_null_counted_absent
criteria.description: A NULL correction on a field whose policy counts null as absent fails a has prerequisite.

criteria.name: exec_correction_first_arrival_only
criteria.description: A correction pinned to a schema the plan revisits is applied on the first arrival only.

criteria.name: exec_correction_at_source_enables_step1
criteria.description: A correction pinned to the source schema applies before the first prerequisite check.

criteria.name: identity_merge_chain
criteria.description: resolve_partner follows a three-link merge chain to its end.

criteria.name: identity_merge_loop_rejected
criteria.description: resolve_partner rejects a merge loop with E_ALIAS_CYCLE.

criteria.name: pipe_rejection_codes
criteria.description: run_pipeline gives each rejected line its catalogue code.

criteria.name: pipe_bad_lines_run_continues
criteria.description: run_pipeline keeps processing lines after lines that are not JSON.

criteria.name: pipe_replay_across_aliases
criteria.description: A resend through another alias of the same canonical partner is replayed.

criteria.name: pipe_token_vs_json_null_conflict
criteria.description: A null token string and a JSON null give different fingerprints, so the resend conflicts.

criteria.name: pipe_edit_dropped_by_migration_conflict
criteria.description: An edit to a field that migration drops still conflicts.

criteria.name: pipe_reissue_supersedes_holder
criteria.description: A REISSUE given through an alias supersedes the holder and migrates the new version.

criteria.name: pipe_received_seq_decides_holder
criteria.description: The manifest received_seq, not the file order, decides which copy is the holder.

criteria.name: pipe_mid_path_failure_record
criteria.description: A correction given through a merged alias breaks the second step and the record is failed at that edge.

criteria.name: pipe_attempted_vs_migrated_counts
criteria.description: The run summary counts a failed execution as attempted and not as migrated.

criteria.name: pipe_invalid_corrections_listed
criteria.description: The run summary lists the malformed, unresolved, never-applied and unmatched corrections.

criteria.name: pipe_partner_token_list_replaces_default
criteria.description: A partner token list replaces the default list during null-token replacement.

criteria.name: summary_categories_from_taxonomy
criteria.description: build_summary assigns categories by code first, in taxonomy order, with zero counts kept.

criteria.name: summary_partner_order
criteria.description: build_summary orders partners by partner_order.tsv rank, unranked partners last by id.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Detects hidden seeds or hidden edge ids embedded in the delivered source.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: Detects output that changes when the same feed is given under another file name.

criteria.name: negative_deleted_visible_tests
criteria.description: Detects visible tests that were removed or stripped of their assertions.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: Detects run output that differs between two runs on the same hidden input.
